description: Figure 2 is a donut-style pie chart summarizing the MULTITURNINSTRUCT dataset composition across capabilities and difficulty levels, with a total of 9 labeled slices arranged around the ring. The slices are color-coded and grouped into three broader difficulty bands shown as concentric/segmented regions: an inner red band labeled “Context Retrieving,” a middle teal/green band labeled “Context Tracking,” and an outer blue band labeled “Conflict Resolving.” The nine capability slices and their displayed counts are: Prioritization (light red/pink, 100), Personalization (red, 100), Privacy Protection (red, 111), Multitasking (red, 160), Memorization (teal/green, 100), Dynamic Instruction (teal/green, 100), Dynamic Environment (blue, 100), Recursive Reasoning (blue, 110), and Triggering (blue, 100). The figure uses leader lines to connect each label to its slice and shows numeric counts (not percentages) next to each capability; there is no separate legend, and no slice appears exploded or otherwise visually emphasized beyond the color grouping and the central labels.
